repair_items.description: Direct subprocess.run() call bypasses centralized run_command() validation wrapper. While the call uses argv array format correctly ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], it lacks audit trail and centralized validation.
repair_items.specific_change: Replace subprocess.run() at line 141 in _get_git_sha() function with: result = await run_command('git rev-parse HEAD', cwd=repo_root). Import run_command from runner.py. Make _get_git_sha() async: async def _get_git_sha(repo_root: Path) -> str. Update all callers to await the function.
repair_items.risk: LOW - minimal refactor from sync subprocess to async run_command wrapper

repair_items.description: Function _get_git_sha() is synchronous but other agents use async run_command(). This creates inconsistency in command execution patterns across the codebase.
repair_items.specific_change: This repair is covered by REPAIR-002. When replacing subprocess.run() with run_command(), the function signature must change to async def _get_git_sha(repo_root: Path) -> str and all callers must be updated to await the call.
